clusters.agenda_text: A second earthquake strikes the province of Granada, in Spain. Damage and injures are reported in Granada and the surrounding area, while the Alhambra is evacuated
clusters.headline: Granada's Alhambra closes after earthquake damages historic site
clusters.summary: An earthquake struck Granada, Spain, causing damage to the Alhambra palace and injuring three people. The historic site subsequently closed due to the structural damage sustained in the seismic event.

clusters.agenda_text: A Spanish F/A-18 Hornet jet shoots down a Russian drone in Romanian airspace. The drone was downed near Galați after entering from Moldova
clusters.headline: Spanish F-18 fighter jet shoots down drone over Romania
clusters.summary: Two Spanish F-18 fighter jets were deployed from their NATO mission in Romania after an alert concerning a drone near the Ukrainian border. During the operation, one of the Spanish fighters shot down a drone that had violated Romanian airspace.

clusters.agenda_text: Three people, including a teenager, are killed and two others are injured in a shooting in Isla Cristina, Andalusia, Spain. Police investigate the attack as a possible dispute between rival drug-trafficking groups and search for the gunman
clusters.headline: Shooting in Spain kills three, including teenager, injures two
clusters.summary: Three people, including a teenager, were killed and two others were injured in a shooting in Isla Cristina, Andalusia, Spain. Police are investigating the attack as a possible dispute between rival drug-trafficking groups and are searching for the gunman.

clusters.agenda_text: Police in Morocco arrest 111 migrants who attempted to enter Spain's autonomous community Ceuta, amidst tightened security on both sides of the border with Spain
clusters.headline: Moroccan police arrest over 100 people at Ceuta border
clusters.summary: Moroccan police arrested more than 100 people who were attempting to enter Ceuta, the Spanish autonomous city located on the North African coast. The arrest took place during what appears to be a coordinated effort by authorities to prevent illegal border crossings into the Spanish enclave.

clusters.agenda_text: A earthquake strikes the province of Granada in Spain, with damage reported in Granada and the surrounding area, and being felt in Madrid
clusters.headline: Earthquake hits Granada, Spain, leaving three people injured
clusters.summary: An earthquake struck the historic city of Granada in Spain, resulting in three people being injured in the event.
